'''Bonitaville''' (Japanese: '''ブロウタウン''' ''Blow Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town in [[Johto]]. It is located between [[Goldenrod City]] and [[Ecruteak City]]. The town hosts the annual [[Pokémon Beauty Contest]].

Following on {{an|Brock}}'s insistence, {{ashfr|the group}} arrived in Bonitaville and met up with [[Suzie]], from which Brock got his {{TP|Brock|Vulpix}}. Brock and Suzie decided to compete in the Pokémon Beauty Contest as a couple with Vulpix. Another {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}} and a friend of Suzie's, [[Zane]], also entered the contest with his {{p|Ninetales}}. After the contest, Brock returned Vulpix to Suzie.
